proposed_capability: PS-0241: source-only open-domain DAG planner and bounded Gaussian-process duration estimation. Compose evidence-qualified per-Sim shopping, inventory transfer, movement/teleport, crafting, career, ecology and other activities with planning/play modes and interruption-proof queue continuation. Reuse native authority, task continuity, semantic advisory, domain cascade, purchase and navigation owners.
operator_correction: Prompt Scratch Idea Inbox A11 describes queued ecology execution before work/needs obligations, separate paused planning and live play, resilient recovery after game autonomy interruptions, bounded Gaussian process learning. Current request generalizes this mathematical and procedural model across every Sims 4 domain rather than ecology alone.
repository_situation: Current main has domain_cascade, semantic_advisory, task_continuity, workflow_interop, purchase_dialog, eco_resource_cycle and traversal_cost_learning. Open PR #252 adds ecology-only planning/play; this separate source-only general layer does not overwrite it. Native issue #171 and BI-002 remain independent.

competing_theses.thesis: Replace domain_cascade with monolithic universal agent scheduler
competing_theses.falsification: Duplicates mature domain policy and grants unsupported game action authority

competing_theses.thesis: Hard-code ecology, career and shopping scripts separately
competing_theses.falsification: Cross-domain prerequisites and reordering still require agents to rediscover generic orchestration

competing_theses.thesis: Use GP as the sole scheduler and infer game permissions from smoothness
competing_theses.falsification: Discontinuous unlocks and player permissions cannot be inferred by regression, and dense GP scales poorly

competing_theses.thesis: Add bounded evidence-driven DAG composition and advisory homogeneous-cohort GP seam, leaving effects to owners
competing_theses.falsification: Reject if unverified shortcuts, duplicate effects, stale observations or budget overruns occur

selected_thesis: Pure open-domain activity DAG with explicit action dependencies, observed mobility routes, conservative time/funds limits, retained per-Sim plans and opt-in cohort-isolated GP forecasts.
player_save_control_impact: No runtime game effect, OS input, automation start, save writes, unapproved purchases or queue cancellation. Existing player presence, scene, save, lot, funds and native game-effect gates remain authoritative.
expected_outcome: Composed acquisition→inventory→travel/teleport→craft/use graphs with deterministic due-date ordering, conservative projected budget, never replay unresolved steps, and evidence-isolated bounded GP estimates. Preview only; native dispatch forbidden.
negative_tests: Insufficient time before work or needs floor
rollback_path: Revert isolated feature branch, no game installation or save touched.
unresolved_unknowns: Actual EA-native current-build hooks, affordances and unlocked teleport evidence
Native persistence/adapters and exact save-qualified queue state
End-to-end local player interrupt and safe game certification under issue #171
GP hyperparameter calibration and large-scale methods require observed cross-context trials
